headline: Learn, connect, and get your questions answered
intro: Free community workshops, enrollment Q&A nights, and small-business sessions across Chicagoland and online. New dates are posted here first.
emptyText: New events are being scheduled. Join the email list to hear first.

events.title: Open Enrollment Q&A Night
events.summary: Bring your questions about health coverage for next year. Learn how plans compare, what changes each year, and how to avoid surprise costs.

events.title: Small Business Benefits Workshop
events.summary: For owners with 1–50 employees: what benefits cost, what employees value most, and simple ways to offer coverage without overspending.

events.title: Protecting Your Paycheck: 1099 Worker Session
events.summary: Independent contractors and gig workers: learn how disability, accident, and sickness plans can replace income if you can't work.

events.title: Turning 65? Medicare Basics (Educational)
events.summary: An educational overview of Medicare parts, enrollment windows, and common mistakes. No plans are sold at this event.
